title: Home page card links to /call-center-qa, which returns 404
description:
**Problem**
A card on the primus.anth.us home page links to /call-center-qa, which does not exist.

**Evidence**
`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://primus.anth.us/call-center-qa` returns 404 (2026-10-20).

**Fix**
Point the card at an existing page or remove the card.

**How to verify**
`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://primus.anth.us/call-center-qa` returns 200, or the home page no longer links to it.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
